capabilities: Draw circuit diagrams in an embedded editor
Embed cells and blocks with wikilink syntax
Navigate to a cell or block from an embed
Open the circuit editor from an embed toolbar
disambiguation: Not an extension of Obsidian Canvas; it draws and embeds electronic circuit diagrams.
extras: Community-store install downloads a ~6 MB circuit.zip from GitHub Releases on first load; a manually placed circuit/ folder is used without download or overwrite.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw circuit schematics and embed selected cells or blocks in notes.
summary: Plugin for drawing circuit diagrams in Obsidian, storing them as .icproj files and embedding cells or blocks in notes.
